description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Costco IT is hiring an Infrastructure Engineer to support the LTL Fulfillment Support and Operations team. The role designs, operates, and secures reliable infrastructure for Costco Logistics and Fulfillment, including cloud platforms, monitoring, automation, and production support.
Infrastructure Engineer for LTL fulfillment operations, applying SRE to design cloud infrastructure, monitoring, IaC automation, and reliability controls

Responsibilities:
• Applies Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles to design, maintain and optimize enterprise monitoring, alerting and log aggregation solutions
• Designs, analyzes and optimizes production and non-production environments, including OS level configuration, patching and capacity management
• Performs deep dive troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) on complex infrastructure and platform issues to minimize downtime and prevent recurrent incidents
• Implements and maintains scalable cloud infrastructure
• Leverages IaC tools and API driven automation to provision, configure and manage infrastructure
• Establishes and monitors SLOs and SLIs to ensure system reliability, availability and performance
• Facilitates overall coordination and supervises the day-to-day tasks required to ensure projects are meeting goals and deadlines
• Responsible for the end to end Change Management lifecycle, including technical risk assessment, cross-functional coordination, and documentation to ensure secure and compliant production releases
• Interfaces with other IT teams and vendors to develop configuration, support and administration standards
• Collaborates with Enterprise Monitoring to provide sufficient monitoring and alerts for defined processing, SLAs, etc
• Creates and maintains detailed, up-to-date technical documentation
• Partners with Supply Chain, IT, and Enterprise monitoring teams to define standards, configurations and disaster recovery procedures
• Implements and enforces security practices, auditing, and compliance standards in alignment with enterprise policies and industry frameworks
• Participates in a 24x7 on call rotation supporting infrastructure stability and availability
• Provides technical escalation support for system incidents
• Analyzes user and project requirements for solutions

Requirements:
• Strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering principles and experience with enterprise monitoring and log aggregation tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Instana and Dynatrace)
• Hands-on experience in troubleshooting, diagnosing deployment failures and analyzing system logs
• Experience in container technologies (Docker/Kubernetes) and automated deployment pipelines, with experience managing and configuring large-scale enterprise applications across Linux, Windows, and containerized environments
• Proven experience in managing and scaling cloud infrastructure, specifically within Azure or equivalent cloud environments
• Proficiency in scripting for automation (Powershell, Python or Bash)
• Strong background in DevOps methodologies
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) hands on experience with configuration management and provisioning tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or ARM templates

Preferred:
• AZ-900, AZ-104, or Linux Foundation Certified System Administrator certified
• Experience with messaging systems, custom-coded Java applications, and databases
• Familiarity with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems) or large-scale retail fulfillment architecture
• Experience with cloud installations or migrations, preferably Azure
• Experience with software installation, configuration, customization, and triage
• General knowledge of client-server systems, preferably in the logistics & fulfillment categories (OMS, WMS, etc)
• General networking experience and knowledge of foundational services and inter-system dependencies
• At least one full cycle implementing a major software application in cloud environments
• Knowledge of large-scale enterprise architectures
• Proficient in Google Workspace applications, including Sheets, Docs, Slides, and Gmail
